Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan Grades.

The Super Saiyan’s hair shoots out in random
directions and they become increasingly bigger, their
pupils fade and they do not get faster, instead wanting
more damage.
Increase your Power by 1
You deal an additional 1d6 to all damage
Decrease your Movement Speed by 20 ft.
You gain +2 Bulk
At the end of your turn, you lose 2 Stamina
